claims.statement: case3-flesh-test is a minimal throwaway repository created solely for the OpenWiki Stage 2 case-3 detail-completion isolation test, not a production or teaching project.
The case-3 test exercises OpenWiki initialization from a near-empty repo and two isolation scenarios: confirm-1 (wiring from scratch) and confirm-9 (token-free visible comparison).

The only source code is a single greet(name) function in pkg/greet.py that returns 'Hello, {name}!' and whose docstring states it exists for the detail-completion isolation test; there is no test suite.

The OpenWiki GitHub Actions workflow at .github/workflows/openwiki-update.yml is the repository's only real changeable operational surface, installing openwiki, running openwiki code --update --print, and opening a PR on the openwiki/update branch.
Generated OpenWiki pages should not be hand-edited; the scheduled OpenWiki GitHub Actions workflow refreshes the wiki, and source code and tests are authoritative over generated docs.

The repository root contains macOS AppleDouble resource-fork artifacts prefixed with ._ (e.g. ._.github, ._AGENTS.md, ._CLAUDE.md, ._README.md, ._pkg) from the external SSD filesystem; these are not source code or documentation and must be ignored for all analysis.
